mean_prediction_loss: Average held-out squared error of the conditional mean on the original log or log-ratio scale; no exponentiation or Jacobian enters squared loss.
scope: Every declared primary and sensitivity fold, with all planned methods and missingness retained; original and refined procedures separate.
group_weights: Observation-weighted and equal-original-group means; no fitting reweighting.
stability: All 199 whole-group or row bootstrap slots and original covariate grid; paired Monte Carlo intervals only.
simulation_risk: All 24 fixed-heterogeneity LD core cells and six local-alternative cells; target zero; all 5000 test covariates; exact generating conditional mean.
note: These are publication reproduction rules. They do not recreate or claim an original before-inspection registration.
